title: Visual Arts - Embodied Making: Performance Art, Images and Objects
institution: Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity
field: Visual arts (including ceramics, digital media, painting, performance art, photography, sculpture)
about: Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity's five-week visual arts residency 'Embodied Making' runs July 5 to August 6, 2027 in Banff, Canada, for individual artists or duos at any career stage. Application deadline: February 17, 2027.
requirements: Individual artists or duos of no more than two collaborators
Available for the full five weeks
Post-secondary visual arts training or equivalent peer recognition
Competence in the proposed production processes
